name: Titles And Names Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals Christ through various powerful titles and names that emphasize His divine authority and redemptive role. He is depicted as the Angel of the Lord who leads and protects God's people, as seen in Exodus where the Angel is sent to guide and whose name embodies God's presence. The name I AM, declared to Moses, affirms Christ's eternal and self-existent nature, while the promise in Genesis that the scepter shall not depart from Judah until Shiloh comes highlights His messianic kingship. These names collectively affirm Christ as the divine Redeemer and sovereign Lord over His people.
